ck.title: Checkout
ck.sub: How the shop takes your customer's payment and details: change them here and the checkout shows them straight away.
ck.note: Grab the handle on the left of a row and drag it to move it (on a phone, press and drag). Or use the arrow buttons. Nothing here moves money or changes a price.
ck.readOnly: You can look but not change. Changing these needs the settings editing permission.
ck.saved: Saved. The checkout shows it now.
ck.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
ck.dragHelp: Press and drag, or use the arrow keys

err.STALE: Someone else changed this just now. It has been read again, so please make your change again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something here is not right. Check the numbers and words and try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: Only an owner can change Cash on Delivery.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this.
err.other: It was not saved. Please try again.

payments.d: Which ways to pay the checkout offers, in what order, and the numbers and accounts your customers send money to.
payments.needOne: A payment way that is switched on needs at least one choice shown.
payments.fillRows: Fill in every number and every bank account, or remove the empty row.
payments.codHelp: Your own decision. Nothing is offered until you choose, and only an owner can change it.
payments.codOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change Cash on Delivery.
payments.walletsHelp: Your bKash, Nagad, Rocket or Upay numbers. A Bangladesh mobile number can be typed as 01XXXXXXXXX.
payments.banksHelp: The accounts customers can transfer to. Up to 10.
